definitions.explanation: The importance or purpose of something.
The importance or worthiness of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{意義|いぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The significance of this research is great.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{意義|いぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: To contemplate the meaning of life.

examples.japanese: {意義|いぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to do meaningful work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{意義|いぎ}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote a paper on the significance of education.

examples.english: Volunteer work was a meaningful experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{意義|いぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even small daily efforts have value.

notes:
{意義|いぎ} refers to the significance, meaning, or value of something, often in philosophical or evaluative contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {意義|いぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have significance/meaning)
- {意義|いぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (meaningful, significant)
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{意義|いぎ} (the significance of ~)
- {意義|いぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見出|みいだ}す→見出す：14241_miidasu⟧ (to find meaning in)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {意義|いぎ} vs. ⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧: ⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧ is the general word for "meaning" (of words, actions); {意義|いぎ} specifically refers to significance or importance.
- {意義|いぎ} vs. ⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧: ⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧ means "value" or "worth" more concretely; {意義|いぎ} is more about deeper meaning or purpose.

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
⟦{異議|いぎ}→異議：13552_igi⟧ (objection) has the same reading but different kanji and meaning. Context usually clarifies:
- {意義|いぎ}: Meaning, significance
- ⟦{異議|いぎ}→異議：13552_igi⟧: Objection, dissent

Register: Neutral to formal. Common in academic, philosophical, and business contexts.
